description: Crypto technical indicators API: RSI-14, MACD and Bollinger Bands for BTC, ETH and SOL in one GET, no parameters. Returns JSON per asset: rsi14, macd {macd, signal, histogram} (null when there are too few candles), bollinger {upper, middle, lower, period}, lastClose and OKX perpetual funding {fundingRate, fundingTime}. Computed from CoinGecko OHLC closes (Coinbase candles fallback); methodology included. Descriptive only, not advice. Errors are not charged. Price $0.005 per call via x402, USDC on Base (MCP payments are Base only). Data changes about every 5 min; calling more often returns the same values.
name: signals
